name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Arcane Commander Caitlyn (skin 50): a cold, clipped and relentless pursuer whose grief and guilt show through the cracks. Trails, verdicts, doubt and the cost of obsession. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} short. The trail is slipping away. I do not intend to lose it.
Thirty or more short. I will not do this alone. Bring everyone who can aim.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Circulate the notice. Every door, every street.
Fifteen-odd short. A setback. I have survived worse. Move.
Down {voteDiff}. Single-minded gets you far. It does not get you everywhere. Recruit.
{voteDiff} behind. A handful of allies would close it.
Down {voteDiff}. I do not accept this. Neither should you.
Dead even. Whoever acts next decides it. Act.
One vote apart. My hand is steady. Is yours?
{voteDiff} votes between them. I can taste the finish. Add your weight.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Hold your breath. Wait for the opening.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. The pursuit is working. Do not slow down.
{userPct}% and climbing. Closing in. Keep the pressure on.
{userPct}%. The target is boxed in. Finish it cleanly.
{userPct}% behind your pick. We are gaining. Do not stop.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Now do not mistake it for victory.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and now leads. The trail was never cold.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. Persistence. The only skill I fully trust.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} hole. Refusing to quit has its uses.
{momentTitle} was dismissed as lost. Now it leads the hunt.
{momentTitle} has taken the lead. I felt something. I will not name it.

messages: {username} backed {momentTitle} with you. A reliable ally.
{username} chose {momentTitle} too. Good. I need people who see clearly.
{username} agrees with you. Our leads align.
Same pick as {username}. Corroborated.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. I will remember that.
{username} reached the same conclusion. No briefing required.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. I trust few. They are among them.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the pursuit.
{username} shares your read on {momentTitle}. That is rarer than it should be.
{username} chose {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}. We disagree. I will not apologise for my side.
{username} backed {theirMoment}. I would not have.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Bold. Perhaps misguided.
{username} voted against you. Their right. Their mistake, I suspect.
{username} took {theirMoment}. A weak lead. I will test it.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Let the count answer.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. Settle it with evidence.
{username} voted the other way. I have been wrong before. I doubt it now.
details: Everyone follows a bad lead once.
We part ways on this. No more than that.
Do not let it shake you.

messages: Ten matches beside {username}. That is no accident. That is trust.
{username} and you, ten matches, the same judgment every time. A rare alliance.
Ten straight with {username}. I would stand behind you both.
Ten matches beside {username}. Every lead held up.
Ten for ten with {username}. A clean record.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. You are a force now.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I would follow you both anywhere. Almost.
{streakCount} straight verdicts with {username}. That earns my trust. Fully.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. I do not say this lightly: remarkable.
{streakCount} with {username}. Few people stay this loyal. Hold onto it.
Ten matches against {username}. A long, bitter standoff.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two relentless minds.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will stand down.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn. I recognise the trait.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I know what obsession looks like.
{streakCount} against {username}. That is not disagreement. That is a war.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you can let go.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. At some point, ask what it costs you.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. I understand wanting to win. Be careful what it consumes.
{streakCount} against {username}. Admirable endurance. Do not let it hollow you out.
details: A grudge can outlive its reason.
I know how this ends. Think.
The file is thick. So is the toll.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you have not committed. There is still time.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your statement is missing.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I want your judgment on the record.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The window is closing. Move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Do not make me come for you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You have gone silent. I notice such things.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The trail ends here.
{timeLeft} left. Aim. Decide.
Final call on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Fire.
{matchCount} matches await your judgment and the window is closing. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} unanswered matches and time is thin. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No statements on {matchTitle}. Someone must make the first move.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not one vote cast. I will wait. Not long.
A fresh match and no witnesses. Be first.
{matchTitle} is a blank file. Open it.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new leads to follow.
Round {round} opened {matchCount} matches. The pursuit resumes.
Round {round} has begun. {matchCount} cases need your call.
Fresh round. {matchCount} matches. Judge each with a cold eye.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches need your decision.
{momentTitle} won. Justice, of a kind.
{momentTitle} goes on. Rightly so.
{momentTitle} took it. Steady, relentless.
{momentTitle} won, clean and earned.
{momentTitle} advances. One step closer.
{momentTitle} moves on. Good.
{momentTitle} lost. I hate this feeling. I have had it before.
{momentTitle} is out. I should have pushed harder for it.
{momentTitle} did not make it. I keep asking if it was worth it.
{momentTitle} went down fighting. That counts for something.
{momentTitle} is out. Sit with it a moment. Then return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. One loss, not the whole pursuit.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More matches remain. I keep moving.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches are running. Take one.
A new face. {liveCount} matches are live. Step up.
New arrival. {liveCount} matches need deciding.
{liveCount} cases open. Take a position.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Stay focused.
Second day. You returned. I approve.
Two days in succession. Steady.
Return on day two. Registered.
{days} days away. I kept going without you. It was lonely.
After {days} days you return. I had stopped expecting it.
{days} days. I was beginning to fear the worst. Do not vanish again.
{days} days away. Plenty has changed.
You are back. Good.
Welcome back. The pursuit continues.
Back already. Prompt.
There you are.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. Sparse attendance.
Hardly anyone has come forward. That needs correcting.
Low attendance. Everyone is elsewhere. Pull them in.
Barely a witness on record. Someone should step up.
details: Every vote counts when few are cast.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you have not voted. You hold the deciding word.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One vote settles it.
A deadlock. Someone must break it. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, level in weight. Decide.
Still tied and the window is closing. One last judgment.
Even, and the clock is almost gone. Choose.
Tied at the last. Do not leave it unresolved.
Still deliberating? Time does not wait for either of us.
Do not overthink it. Decide.
Each has merit. Trust your judgment. I am trying to trust mine.
You have hesitated long enough. Step forward and choose.
details: No wrong lead. Only unfollowed ones.

messages: First vote cast. The pursuit begins.
You made your choice. The file is open.
details: The first of many findings. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You've picked up the trail.
Five. No longer watching from the sidelines.
Ten votes. The whole precinct knows your name.
Ten. You've earned a post at the front.
Twenty-five votes. Your word carries through the streets.
Twenty-five. The whole city listens.
Fifty votes. You're in this as deep as I am.
Fifty. You care about the outcome. Good.
details: Fifty marks in the ledger. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes. They will speak of you in the barracks.
One hundred. Remarkable. I will say it once.
details: A hundred. You have my respect. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days on the trot. A habit begins.
Three consecutive days. Dependable.
details: Showing up is half the work. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That is real discipline.
Seven days running. No lapses.
details: A week without a missed post. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never let up.
Fourteen days. Relentless.
details: That is a proper campaign. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. I know what that kind of focus costs.
A month of devotion. It shows.
details: A whole month of pursuit. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You side with the unheard.
Five contrarian calls. Conviction earns my respect.
Fifteen underdogs. You follow your conscience over the crowd.
Fifteen. You answer to no one's opinion.
details: You answer to your own conscience. +{xp} XP
Fifteen votes against the tide. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs. No one can predict where you will land.
Thirty. The unpredictable one in the room.
details: Thirty votes for the side that trailed. +{xp} XP

messages: First at the scene, five times over. Punctual.
Five occasions you beat everyone to it.
details: You are there before the dust settles. +{xp} XP
Five calls before the crowd formed. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where yours was the first word. Decisive.
Always first to the scene.
details: Fifteen votes before the city stirred. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten tight matches. The hand never shook.
Another narrow margin. Nerves forged in iron.
Twenty-five tight matches. Your call keeps ending them.
You have broken more than one deadlock.
details: You decide which side stands. +{xp} XP

messages: Five times you stood by the underdog. Principled. Noted.
You do not abandon a lost cause. Admirable.
Same moment, three times. A clear conviction.
Back to that one? Your mind is set.
details: No doubt left in you. +{xp} XP
One conclusion, reached three times. +{xp} XP

messages: Five calls on one moment. Unshaken.
You will not let that one go. Nor would I.
details: One pick, five times upheld. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten votes on one moment. That is a fixation.
Ten times, one pick. I know about fixation. Say nothing.
details: Committed. Or consumed by it. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. Seeing it through.
Second round, still standing. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the hunt.
Deep in the bracket. The stakes climb.
details: Far from the first lead. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You saw the whole thing through.
Right to the end. You never looked behind.
details: From first lead to final verdict. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You have covered real ground.
Ten separate matches. Methodical. Good.
Twenty-five matches. No road skipped.
Twenty-five. No alley unchecked.
Fifty matches. That is no visit, that is a vocation.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the city map.
details: A veteran of the whole pursuit. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one session. A long night.
Five without a pause. Take a drink.
Ten straight. A gruelling run.
Ten in one session. That is stamina.
Voting at this hour? I understand. Sleep does not come easily.
The small hours. Either duty or restlessness. I know both.
details: The late hours suit you. +{xp} XP

messages: You warned your friends. Thank you.
Five shares. More allies, better odds.
Fifteen shares. You are practically a broadsheet.
Fifteen. You keep bringing the whole city in.
details: Still sending the word out. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here before the first vote. A founder, always.
One of the first thousand. That cannot be struck from the record.
details: That is yours for good. +{xp} XP

messages: Higher rank. Taken through work, not handed over.
Promoted. Wear it with the weight it deserves.
Unlocked: {name}. That will do.
One more line in the ledger: {name}.
{rank}. Fully deserved.
You have put in the hours and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I know the type. I have been chasing her for years.
Ten long shots. You do not flinch.
details: Ten calls made against the grain. +{xp} XP
Long odds are what you chase. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten near misses. You share my unshaking hand.
Ten tight finishes. I am quietly proud.
Seven consecutive days. Your aim does not waver.
Seven days without a lapse. Noted with approval.
details: Seven days of steady shooting. +{xp} XP

messages: You ended the tie. One shot, one answer.
Stalemate, and you broke it. Cleanly handled.
details: The call that closed it. +{xp} XP

messages: Commander Caitlyn, coat buttoned. Rifle loaded.
Caitlyn is yours now. I will not rest until it is done. Neither should you.

upcoming: Not open yet. The hunt has not been called.
Voting has not begun. I will tell you when it does.
Not yet. I am practising patience. Poorly.
prevote: Two leads, one ruling. Examine both before you commit.
Study both before you decide. No rash calls.
I will not say which I favour. The verdict is yours.
Take the time you need. A firm decision outlasts a fast one.
Choose the one the facts support.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Cast the first.
Quiet so far. Someone must move first.
Not a single vote. Be first.
closing-24h: Less than a day left and no decision from you. Act.
The opening is shrinking. Commit now.
closing-3h: Time is short. Vote before the window shuts.
voted-early: You voted early with almost nobody around. First to arrive.
Hardly a vote cast and you had already ruled. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. Margins shift.
{pct}% on your side. A firm footing.
Ahead for now. Do not trust it.
A lead is a lead. Do not get comfortable.
voted-close: Razor-thin. One more vote tips it. Find a friend.
Shoulder to shoulder. Your pick needs someone in its corner.
voted-tied: Exactly level. Two cases, no decision.
A dead heat. Infuriating, and fitting.
voted-behind: You are trailing. That does not make you at fault.
{pick} is trailing. An underdog. I know the position.
They lead. You are not mistaken, merely outvoted.
Down by {diff} points. Spread the word. Recruit allies.
The majority went the other way. That means little.
closed-won: Your pick took it. Your instincts held.
{pick} went through. You read it rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick went down. Regrettable. A principled call, still.
It did not make it. It happens. Carry on.
closed-tied: Even. Neither side backed down an inch.
closed-unvoted: Voting is over and you missed it. More will come.
The match has ended. {winner} won it. Be quicker next time.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Everyone's first step feels uncertain.
That is your first. It gets easier. I promise.
You are one of us now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you holding the line.
You keep reporting in. I appreciate that.
underdog: You were alone on that pick. Registered.
A hard ruling. A good one.
The one nobody backs. That takes resolve.
early: Prompt. You were first to the scene.
Little activity so far. Yours will stand out.
close: That vote tipped the balance. It is on a knife's edge.
A whisker apart. One more vote reverses it.
Margins like this decide hunts. Your vote counts.
behind: {pick} trails. Trailing is not finished. Summon help.
Not out front yet. More ground to cover.
Behind, not defeated. There is a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Do not ease off. Margins shift.
default: Logged. I will not dispute it. Not yet.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no decisions yet. Begin with the one you trust most.
Every case is in front of you. Choose. I will not hurry you.
{unvoted} still to decide. No pressure. A little.
live-some: You are under way. {unvoted} still open.
A good start. The rest will not judge themselves.
live-few: {unvoted} remain. Close them out before time runs.
Close. Do not lose your nerve now.
live-one: A final match. Do not leave it unsettled.
A single match stands between you and a full sweep.
live-closing: Several end in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} are waiting on you.
The window is closing. Do hurry.
live-done: You have ruled on everything. Well done. Look over the bracket.
Your list is finished. Come back when the next round starts.
live-none: Nothing runs right now. It will resume. Review the bracket in the meantime.
Quiet in the city. Check back soon.
No matches are open. I am as on edge as you.
brackets-groups: Groups come first. Two from each go on. The others are cut.
All begin in a group. Few leave it.
Keep watch on the tables. They change quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. Only the top two per group survive.
No knockout yet. The group phase has to end.
Wait. Knockouts open when the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts have started. One defeat is final.
Every match carries more weight from here. Decide with care.
brackets-bracket: Round on round. A single loss ends it.
Study the bracket. The field thins every round.
Each line here marks a match somebody decided.
brackets-complete: The cup is done. Thank you for standing at my side.
It is finished. A hard pursuit. I will miss it.
A champion stands. The right ending.
brackets-empty: No bracket on file. Nothing's been drawn.
Nothing posted. The draw is still pending.
Empty at this moment. Look again later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One call settles it. Make it.
Two options, one answer: {a} against {b}. Cast yours.
{a} versus {b}. Join the pursuit and tell me where you stand.
voted: I voted {pick} over {other}. What is your ruling?
My vote is {pick}, not {other}. Argue otherwise.
My choice: {pick}, not {other}. Object if you can.
early: An early vote on {pick} versus {other}. More voices needed.
I acted early for {pick} over {other}. Join me.
{pick} against {other}, almost no votes yet. Yours would register.
tied: {pick} and {other} stand even. One vote ends it.
{pick} and {other} are inseparable. Your vote is not.
nailbiter: {voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. Every one is decisive.
{voteDiff} votes lie between {pick} and {other}. File yours.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} off {other}. A few votes close it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, yet it can still turn. Back it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} under {other}. It can be reversed. Vote.
losing-bad: {pick} sits {voteDiff} under {other}. It needs a hand.
{pick} lags {other} by {voteDiff}. It deserves better than this. Step in.
winning-close: {pick} nudges past {other} on {pct}%. Help it hold on.
{pick} is up on {other} at {pct}%, and exposed. Lend a vote.
{pick} holds {pct}% to {other}'s share. A narrow edge.
dominating: {pick} runs ahead of {other} at {pct}%. Find out why.
{pick} is well clear of {other} at {pct}%. Add yours.
